title: tephroseris pricei
intro: Tephroseris pricei, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a perennial plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, and other health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Everlasting include sedative, anti-spasmodic, and diuretic properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions like insomnia, muscle spasms, and urinary disorders. The bioactive constituents of Tephroseris pricei include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
